description: Arras Energy GridLAB-D, published by arras-energy, provides an electricity-infrastructure simulation environment derived from DOE GridLAB-D and HiPAS GridLAB-D, with Python integration, solver modules and several data formats. Coverage: The documented software is configured for the chosen system; the reviewed pages establish no fixed geographic coverage, spatial resolution or time horizon. Source and documentation are publicly accessible through the repository; no model files were downloaded or executed. Licence: BSD-3-Clause, read from the repository's licence file on 2026-09-27; obtaining it is free of charge. The free cost label refers to repository access; external software or services can have separate costs. Limitations: This is the Arras derivative; upstream GridLAB-D documentation does not establish identical features or support. For catalogue screening, its documented functions support network flow, capacity planning studies; this is an assessment of possible use, not a claim of validated performance. Related records: No directly related catalogue record was established from the reviewed sources.
